rows.ja: 供給元(Cisco向けの販売先として記載)
AI・インフラ・ソフトの提携先

relations.text: Viavi Solutionsの年次報告が、Ciscoを顧客例に挙げている
relations.text_en: Viavi Solutions' annual report lists Cisco Systems, Inc. among its example customers

source.label: Viavi Solutions 10-K
source.quote: Examples of our customers include Advanced Micro Devices, Inc., América Móvil, AT&T Inc., British Telecom Openreach, Ciena, Cisco Systems, Inc., Deutsche Telekom AG, Ericsson, Lumen Technologies, Inc., Nokia Corporation and Verizon Communications Inc.
source.note: Viaviの顧客としての記載です。

relations.text: CiscoはNVIDIA Spectrum-Xスイッチ用シリコンとCisco OSを組み合わせたシステムを提供する、としている
relations.text_en: Cisco says it is the premier partner delivering partner-developed systems featuring NVIDIA Spectrum-X switch silicon paired with a Cisco operating system

source.label: Cisco — Secure AI Factory with NVIDIA, March 16, 2026
source.label_en: Cisco — Secure AI Factory with NVIDIA, March 16, 2026
source.quote: Cisco is the premier partner to deliver partner-developed systems featuring NVIDIA Spectrum-X switch silicon paired with a Cisco operating system, providing customers the flexibility of leveraging both NVIDIA Cloud Partner-compliant reference architectures and Cisco Silicon One-based architectures.

relations.text: Cisco Silicon One搭載のAIネットワークで構築したAMD Instinct MI355X GPUベースのAI基盤が、HUMAIN向けに稼働している
relations.text_en: AMD Instinct MI355X GPU-based AI infrastructure built on Cisco Silicon One-based AI networking is live and serving HUMAIN customers

source.label: Cisco — Secure AI Factory with NVIDIA, March 16, 2026
source.label_en: Cisco — Secure AI Factory with NVIDIA, March 16, 2026
source.quote: Cisco and HUMAIN, announced that AMD Instinct MI355X GPU-based AI infrastructure built on Cisco Silicon One-based AI networking is now live in Saudi Arabia and serving HUMAIN customers in the Kingdom and beyond.

relations.text: CiscoはSupermicroと組み、ラックスケールのAI計算ソリューションを製品群に加える
relations.text_en: Cisco, partnering with Supermicro, adds rack-scale AI computing solutions to its portfolio

source.label: Cisco — Supermicro rack-scale collaboration, August 25, 2026; announced October availability
source.label_en: Cisco — Supermicro rack-scale collaboration, August 25, 2026; announced October availability
source.quote: Cisco, partnering with Supermicro, adds rack-scale AI computing solutions to its portfolio, delivering end-to-end infrastructure to run massive AI workloads, reduce deployment risk, and help customers run workloads with greater efficiency and control over data.

relations.text: CiscoはSupermicroの液冷・空冷システムを提供する
relations.text_en: Cisco will offer Supermicro liquid- and air-cooled systems

source.label: Cisco — Supermicro rack-scale collaboration, August 25, 2026; announced October availability
source.label_en: Cisco — Supermicro rack-scale collaboration, August 25, 2026; announced October availability
source.quote: Through this new partnership, Cisco will offer Supermicro liquid- and air-cooled systems, giving customers access to rack-scale and dense GPU systems – validated and sold as part of the broader Cisco AI infrastructure portfolio.

relations.text: NetAppの年次報告が、NVIDIA、Cisco、Microsoftなどとの協業を挙げている
relations.text_en: NetApp's annual report cites collaborations with technology leaders such as NVIDIA, Cisco, and Microsoft

source.label: NetApp 10-K
source.quote: Collaborations with technology leaders such as NVIDIA, Cisco, Microsoft, and a broad network of channel partners enable us to deliver integrated, best-in-class solutions tailored to diverse customer needs.

companies.name: Box
companies.sub: クラウドコンテンツ管理

relations.text: Boxの年次報告が、Ciscoなどとの連携を持つ技術パートナーに挙げている
relations.text_en: Box's annual report lists Cisco among technology partners with which it offers integrations

source.label: Box 10-K
source.quote: We have a rich technology partner ecosystem, offering integrations with partners such as Adobe, Apple, Cisco, CrowdStrike, Google, Guidewire, IBM, Microsoft, Okta, Oracle-NetSuite, Palo Alto Networks, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Slack, USDM, Workday, and Zoom.

relations.text: Dropboxの年次報告が、Ciscoなどとの連携があると記している
relations.text_en: Dropbox's annual report says it has integrations with vendors including Cisco

source.label: Dropbox 10-K
source.quote: We also have integrations with Microsoft, Adobe, Apple, Salesforce, Atlassian, Slack (now part of Salesforce), BetterCloud, Google, IBM, Cisco, VMware, Okta, Symantec, Palo Alto Networks, Zoom, and a variety of other productivity, collaboration, data management, and security vendors.

companies.name: Nutanix
companies.sub: ハイブリッドクラウド

relations.text: Nutanixは、Cisco UCSブレードサーバーをNutanix AHV向けに認定するためCiscoと取り組んだ
relations.text_en: Nutanix worked with Cisco to certify Cisco UCS blade servers for Nutanix AHV

source.label: Nutanix 10-K
source.quote: We have also worked with Cisco to certify Cisco UCS blade servers for Nutanix AHV, enabling organizations to repurpose existing qualified server deployments.

relations.text: Bandwidthは、CiscoのWebex Callingとの接続提携を持つ
relations.text_en: Bandwidth has BYOC partnerships including Webex Calling by Cisco

source.label: Bandwidth 10-K
source.quote: We have BYOC partnerships with leading UCaaS platforms, including Microsoft Teams Direct Routing and Operator Connect, Zoom Phone Provider Exchange, Webex Calling by Cisco, and Google Voice for Google Workspace.

relations.text: Bandwidthは、CiscoのWebex Contact Centerとの接続提携を持つ
relations.text_en: Bandwidth has BYOC partnerships including Webex Contact Center by Cisco

source.label: Bandwidth 10-K
source.quote: We have BYOC partnerships with leading CCaaS platforms, including Five9, Genesys, Webex Contact Center by Cisco, and Zoom Contact Center.

relations.text: Bank of America, N.A.が管理代理人を務めるクレジット契約(2024年2月2日付)をCiscoが締結している
relations.text_en: Cisco has a Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated February 2, 2024 with Bank of America, N.A. as administrative agent

source.label: Cisco 10-K
source.quote: 10.6† Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, dated as of February 2, 2024, by and among Cisco Systems, Inc., certain lenders party thereto, and Bank of America, N.A., as administrative agent, swing line lender and letter of credit issuer
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。
